# Repositorio UNEATLANTICO

> > UNEATLANTICO's institutional repository for open access scientific research, publications, and academic production across multiple languages and disciplines.

The Repositorio UNEATLANTICO is Europe University of Atlantic's digital repository for scholarly works, theses, and research outputs. It supports multilingual browsing (Spanish, English, Portuguese) and provides comprehensive metadata export in standard formats including Dublin Core, RDF, METS, BibTeX, Atom, and RSS feeds.

## Repository Access & Browsing

- [Repositorio UNEATLANTICO Homepage](https://repositorio.uneatlantico.es): UNEATLANTICO institutional repository homepage for scientific research and publications
- [Browse by Open Access](https://repositorio.uneatlantico.es/view/access/open.html): Open access research articles and scientific production browsing interface
- [Browse Spanish-Language Research](https://repositorio.uneatlantico.es/view/language/es.html): Spanish-language research publications and academic repository browsing
- [Browse English-Language Research](https://repositorio.uneatlantico.es/view/language/en.html): English-language research articles and scientific production browsing
- [Browse Portuguese-Language Research](https://repositorio.uneatlantico.es/view/language/pt.html): Portuguese-language thesis and academic research browsing interface

## Biomedical & Clinical Research

- [Effects of a 12-week multicomponent exercise programme on physical function in older adults with cancer: ONKO-FRAIL Study](https://repositorio.uneatlantico.es/id/eprint/17889): ONKO-FRAIL cancer exercise intervention study protocol for older adults using Short Physical Performance Battery (SPPB) assessment
- [Efficacy of liposomal amphotericin B for treating post-kala-azar dermal leishmaniasis (PKDL)](https://repositorio.uneatlantico.es/id/eprint/17868): Systematic review and meta-analysis of amphotericin B for leishmaniasis treatment
- [Constraint of Lignin–Carbohydrate Complex Orchestrated on Polyphenol in Oil–Water Interface Targeting Ulcerative Colitis Therapy](https://repositorio.uneatlantico.es/id/eprint/27827): Polyphenol emulsion system research for ulcerative colitis therapy

## Engineering & Computer Science Research

- [Benchmarking multiple instance learning architectures from patches to pathology for prostate cancer detection and grading using attention-based weak supervision](https://repositorio.uneatlantico.es/id/eprint/27825): Deep learning benchmark for prostate cancer detection using weak supervision and machine learning pathology analysis
- [Securing internet of things devices using a hybrid approach](https://repositorio.uneatlantico.es/id/eprint/27826): IoT security research using hybrid encryption and cryptographic approaches
